identity.title: Use fresh sessions for standard SRP review

values.task_boundary: Document and prove the existing SRP handoff to a fresh external review session.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: standard SRP remains sole review authority
AC-2: exact-head SRP goes to a fresh non-inheriting session
AC-3: reviewer is read-only and reports findings first with file/line evidence
AC-4: actionable findings are resolved and substantive changes trigger fresh review
AC-5: review depth matches docs, code, or authority-critical scope
AC-6: no new orchestration or lifecycle machinery
